about: Taskbar button menus in Windows 11 wording ("Pin to taskbar", "Unpin from taskbar") without KDE's widget settings and edit mode entries; window tooltips with Windows' plain close glyph; no spinning circle over a starting app. The icons-only taskbar (org.kde.plasma.icontasks) uses this package's QML. Matched against plasma-desktop 6.3.6 (Debian 13); several windows of one app show as a stacked button, without Plasma's plus sign, like Windows 11. A program's progress (downloads, copies) is a thin bar under the icon, as on Windows 11, not Plasma's filled area behind it.

replacements.why: progress as a thin bar under the icon, like Windows 11 (product owner, 2026-10-21: Plasma's fill behind the icon looked wrong during a Firefox download)
